subject.title: Feishu: bot does not respond when @-mentioned in a reply message

question: Should maintainers adopt or replace the conflicting fork candidate for this Feishu reply-mention bug, or wait for that author to rebase it before any new target-repository repair is queued?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and still present, but an open conflicting fork PR already targets it and the previous same-repository PR was closed unmerged with proof and safety concerns.

options.title: Adopt or replace the candidate
options.body: Use the existing fork PR as source context, but land a current-main target-repository fix with bot-specific mention evidence and routing tests.

options.title: Wait for the fork author
options.body: Keep this issue open while asking the fork author to rebase and address the prior proof and safety concerns.

options.title: Defer Feishu reply work
options.body: Leave this as a known Feishu channel bug until channel ownership bandwidth is available.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace the candidate
recommendation.body: Use the existing fork PR as source context, but land a current-main target-repository fix with bot-specific mention evidence and routing tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu mention-handling work makes this the closest available routing candidate for the safe detection shape.
